contract: The authored SourceLoader retains file/registration/notification policy. evalPersisting: and evalPersisting:from: retain diagnostic nil versus evaluated Error behavior and native failures, then transfer the original continuation to the compiled Block. File I/O stays with System. The existing backend filename/persistence/synchronous request now uses Oops. No Id contract or Execution frame change.
compatibility: Reflected Method wrong-arity calls return nil as the retained wrapper did.
Syntax diagnostics retain the filename, line/column and caret; valid nil clears stale diagnostics.
Duplicate-source nil still permits evaluation without replacing the registered source.
Namespace-only Module load notification remains distinct from Globals.
Codegen is selected after the file read and retained across a rebinding String constructor; callbacks collect.
embedding: Retained lexical shadowing and path/size validation are reused. Sibling binary bytes are copied at compile time and remain available after asset deletion. Filenames reach nested frame descriptors.
lifetime: A loaded body suspends in its owning Machine and resumes after source-file deletion, rebinding and GC without replaying its effects.
scope: Source-file loading/evaluation/embedding. Artifact admission, recovery, complete bootstrap/Host, images/workers and installed qualification remain pending; pending_source.rs retains only Generation projection.
